title: Jeffrey Ketland
text: These are the webpages of Jeffrey Ketland. I am a retired Philosopher of Science. I retired in late 2025 as a Research Professor at the University of Warsaw. Prior to that, I have worked at the London School of Economics, and Kings College London, and the Universities of Nottingham, Cambridge, Leeds, Edinburgh, Munich and Oxford. My CV can be found by the link in the sidebar.

title: CV - Jeffrey Ketland
text:
This is my CV. A pdf version can be found here.
Born: 20 March 1964, Birmingham, England
Education
1975 – 1982: King Edwards Camp Hill School for Boys, Birmingham. 1982 – 1985: Trinity College, Cambridge. (Theoretical Physics) 1985 – 1986: Trinity College, Cambridge. (Part III Maths Tripos) 1990 – 1992: University of Warwick. (MA Philosophy) 1994 – 1998: London School of Economics & Political Science. (PhD Philosophy of Science)
Work
1991 – 1991: Teaching Assistant. University of Warwick. 1996 – 1998: Temporary Lecturer. Richmond College. 1996 – 1998: Teaching Assistant. LSE. 1996 – 1999: Temporary Lecturer. LSE. 2000 – 2001: University of Nottingham. 2001 – 2002: Kings College London. 2002 – 2003: University of Leeds. 2003 – 2004: University of Cambridge. 2004 – 2011: University of Edinburgh. 2011 – 2012: University of Munich. 2012 – 2016: University of Oxford. 2019 – 2025: University of Warsaw.
